name: query_customers
description: Filter and rank active customers by tier, lifecycle stage, industry, size band (SME, Mid, Whale), health flag (Healthy, Watch, At risk) or renewal window.

name: get_customer_detail
description: Full profile for one customer: health, dimension scores, contacts, tickets, milestones, plays, recent documents, recommendation.

name: get_health_breakdown
description: Weekly health scores by dimension with warning tags for one customer, newest first. Use to explain why a score changed.

name: get_usage_trend
description: Weekly active users, seat utilisation and queries for one customer.
example: Is C0087 still using the product?

name: get_ticket_stats
description: Support ticket counts, escalations, reopens and first response time per account over a window; optionally one customer or only problem accounts.

name: get_renewal_pipeline
description: Upcoming renewals with ARR and health, optionally only accounts at or below a health score.
example: Which renewals are at risk next quarter?

name: get_alerts_digest
description: Today's prioritised alert digest: new At-risk accounts, renewal risks, champion loss, opportunities, with suggested next steps.
example: What should the team look at today?

name: search_documents
description: Hybrid semantic plus keyword search over ticket threads, CSM call notes, QBR notes and NPS comments. Pass a natural-language query and, for exact terms such as competitor names, keywords. Can filter by customer or doc_type (ticket_thread, call_note, qbr_note, nps_comment).

name: find_similar_customers
description: Customers with a similar profile and warning signs that were At risk before, and how they turned out (churned, recovered, still at risk).
example: Who looks like C0142 and what happened to them?

name: get_cohort_retention
description: Cohort tables: size bands, coverage tiers and signup-quarter retention, including gross and net revenue retention.
example: Do SME or whales retain better?

name: get_rfm_segments
description: Usage-based RFM segments (Champions, Loyal, Promising, Light users, Need attention, At risk, Cannot lose, Hibernating) with counts, ARR and top customers.

name: compare_play_outcomes
description: Treated vs control outcomes for a lifecycle play (onboarding_stall, adoption_nudge, champion_loss, renewal_readiness, expansion_signal), including A/B variants.

name: recommend_next_action
description: Rule-based next best action for one customer with the reason.
example: What should I do about C0087?

name: draft_outreach
description: Draft a short personalised outreach email for one customer using its context. DRAFT ONLY, never sent.

name: create_alert_rule
description: Record an alert rule (segment all, whale, mid or sme; metric health_score, seat_utilisation or score_change_4w; operator and value). Records only; evaluation by n8n is not connected yet.
example: Alert me if any whale drops below 60

name: send_for_approval
description: Queue a drafted message for human approval. Nothing is sent.

name: handoff_to_csm
description: Record a request to move a customer from digital to CSM-led coverage, for a human to confirm.
